})

# Reorder columns exactly as target schema

                 'MONTHS_AGE', 'CANCEL_DT', 'CITY', 'POP', 'COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM', 'INBOUND_CALLS_NUM',
                 'KEYWORDS_NUM', 'VISITS_NUM', 'TECHSUPPORT_NUM', 'INTERACTIONS_NUM']
